name: Out of line
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate an arresting, original, exquisitely designed desktop website hero for Perry, a hand-drawn Mac companion. Single 1536x1024 landscape screenshot. This is creative exploration. User rejected literal paper peels and pop-up books as boring and generic. They liked expressive ink lettering and a tiny character inhabiting a black-paper slit. Push well beyond those references.
Concept OUT OF LINE. The web page is immaculate almost-white ruled notebook paper: extremely faint horizontal graphite rules spaced widely, one pale lemon vertical margin line at x=180. Top left tiny hand-lettered 'perry'; upper right restrained 'Meet Perry ↗'. Main graphic is an absolutely enormous, beautifully composed black handwritten headline, exactly 'a little\nout of line.' filling the left and middle 70 percent of the viewport, expressive thick dry ink, confident editorial lettering, deliberately asymmetrical, a remarkable graphic poster. Line breaks intentionally two lines. The dot of the i is a tiny scribble. One notebook rule, previously perfectly straight across the page, has been pulled OUT OF ITS PRINTED POSITION by Perry. At right a small black-ink stick person with big round unfilled head, exactly two vertical oval eyes, no mouth, thin lively limbs, leans backwards gripping the lifted rule with both hands. It now arcs up into an astonishing elegant sweeping loop around part of the headline, passes under Perry like a tightrope, and ends as a loose black thread, with understated sketched tension marks. Only this ONE rule is dark and lifted; all remaining rules remain straight and faint. The result is rebellious, intelligent visual wit, like a drawing breaking the laws of its own page. No 3D character, no large cartoon body, no pen.
Bottom-left clean, small modern sans type exactly 'A companion with a mind of its own. And a hand for your Mac.' Bottom right simple compact black button with white 'Meet Perry'. Tiny handwritten 'borrowed this.' near the missing part of the rule. Tiny sun/moon mode control in navigation. Tasteful pure black / paper white / restrained pale lemon palette. Plenty of breathing room around a very large graphic gesture. Adult art-book design, superb letterforms, haptic ink edges, microscopic paper grain. No physical notebook, folded pages, book spine, laptop, UI card, app screenshot, gradient, decorative doodle clutter, tape, paper curl, bento, fake metrics, generic SaaS hero. Make the page itself the thing Perry plays with.

name: Inside the ink
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a striking and highly original finished website hero for Perry, the ink stick-figure Mac companion. One landscape desktop screen 1536x1024. No outer mockup or design-board framing.
Concept INSIDE THE INK. Monumental black calligraphic ink dominates a clean ivory sketchbook page. One enormous thick dry-brush black oval loop takes up the center/right 70 percent, roughly like a monumental lowercase cursive e without being a readable word. Its dense velvet black stroke is 200px thick, organically frayed, a sculptural almost-flat ink gesture, NOT a shiny liquid puddle. Here is the impossible invention: a beautifully precise tiny warm-white rectangular doorway has opened INSIDE the solid black brushstroke at its lower-right curve. Within that negative space, a tiny two-eyed round-headed black stick person Perry is stepping out carrying a white line as if it is a length of string. The white line extends behind him INTO the black ink, where it outlines an intimate miniature desk, a simple document and small folder. These minimal interior details are only ivory pen strokes, a hidden drawing living INSIDE the ink. No realistic office, no lamp, no shelving, no paper diorama, no black horizontal theatre slit. The mascot is about 110px tall, no mouth, no clothes, arms and legs in loose black ink; he bridges negative and positive space by changing from ivory outline inside the black stroke to black outline on the white paper. His head turns toward the visitor. Extraordinary figure-ground optical trick with readable physical logic.
Upper-left restrained small 'perry'. Main headline at left in tall, narrow, sophisticated black sans lettering, exactly 'There’s life\nin the ink.' large but smaller than the central ink loop. Under it clean 20px copy 'Meet your Mac’s other pair of hands.' One understated black capsule button 'Meet Perry ↗'. Top right sun/moon control. Keep at least 35 percent calm negative space. One thin pale-yellow underline below 'life', no other color. Black shape is the dominant composition and should feel powerful, graphic and arresting from across a room. Microscopic paper grain, perfect ink density, simple confident typography. NO calligraphy writing random text, no 3D popup books, no paper tears, no robot, no gradients, no glossy rendering, no cartoon house, no scattered stars, no interface cards, no fake endorsements. This is adult experimental graphic design with a very small, deeply charming visual surprise.

name: Between the pages
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a radical yet beautifully legible Perry website homepage as an experimental tracing-paper drawing. Single 1536x1024 landscape screenshot. A premium editorial identity in COLD WHITE AND COBALT BALLPOINT BLUE, intentionally distinct from beige and black notebook clichés.
Concept BETWEEN THE PAGES. The website has TWO slightly offset sheets of translucent architectural tracing vellum filling the entire viewport, no visible book or tabletop. Top layer is almost-white, sharply printed clean typography. Beneath it a huge loose cobalt ballpoint drawing of Perry's circular head, with exactly two tiny vertical eyes and no mouth, occupies the right half, partly obscured by milky translucent paper. His thin drawn arm reaches from behind the vellum, and his little hand has pushed through a very narrow horizontal slot in the front layer near center. The hand holds a blue hand-drawn cursor arrow, presenting it to the visitor. The rest of his stick body is only faintly visible behind the sheet, creating a beautiful near/far illusion. A second, SMALL clear cobalt full-body Perry stands on the front layer at lower-right looking up at the giant ghosted drawing behind it: two views of ONE character in different depths, not unrelated mascots. Tiny precise pencil construction lines and one faint offset wordmark create subtle print registration effects, no technical data or fake measurements. Vellum edges visible only at top-right and lower-left with extremely soft shallow shadows, NO curling paper, peeling corner or ripping.
At upper-left small custom monoline cobalt 'perry'. Large intensely confident blue sans-serif headline at left, exactly 'Right here.\nJust underneath.' Use condensed grotesk with 1970s experimental design-magazine character, disciplined tracking, 100px scale. Small legible supporting text 'A little help, one gesture away.' and rectangular COBALT CTA 'Meet Perry' in white. Upper-right minimal 'Light / Dark' theme text. One tiny handwritten caption by the proffered cursor: 'need a hand?'. Generous whitespace, elegant purposeful composition, subtle ballpoint hatching inside the large head outline, fine frosted translucency rather than glassmorphism. This should feel like a remarkable artist's print that has become a functioning web page. Use only cobalt, white, and very faint gray. No yellow. No collage labels, masking tape, paperclip, pop-up book, laptop hardware, generic UI cards, gradient glow, illustration wallpaper. The character's simple two-eye identity is essential. Both mystery and friendliness, never creepy.

name: The impossible page
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an ambitious, visually coherent homepage concept for Perry, a tiny stick-person Mac companion. One finished landscape web screenshot 1536x1024. Art direction: impossible geometry made from hand-drawn ink on charcoal sketch paper, a graphic illusion rather than 3D product rendering.
Concept THE IMPOSSIBLE PAGE. Deep almost-black uncoated paper, rich subtle grain. At center-right an immense continuous ivory hand-drawn window outline creates a recursive spatial illusion: one large 800px-wide perspective rectangle is connected by its lower edge to a smaller inset rectangle, then a still smaller one, like a beautifully designed Droste tunnel or impossible Penrose gallery, three levels ONLY. The outlines should feel drawn with soft wax pencil, not neon. Each rectangular opening is mostly empty black space; tiny top-center notches identify them as computer screens without drawing hardware or detailed UI. One loose ivory line runs from the foreground rectangle into the smaller rectangle and returns to the foreground, with geometrically convincing crossings. At the front lower-right corner, tiny ivory stick-figure Perry (large round head, two vertical eyes, no mouth, spare limbs) passes a single yellow paper square backward THROUGH the second rectangle to his own other hand emerging from the smallest rectangle. The gesture connects distant depths like an impossible shortcut. One character using both ends of a recursive world; one visible head, no army of repeated mascots. The drawing is lucid and spare, quietly mind-bending, structurally precise. Fine black occlusion at each crossing clarifies over/under. Tiny yellow square is the only color.
Typography: tiny ivory handwritten 'perry' upper-left. At left, enormous clean wide grotesk headline exactly 'Small friend.\nStrange powers.' in warm ivory, around 90px. Supporting text exactly 'Help that reaches across your Mac.' Simple ivory rectangular CTA below 'Meet Perry' in black. Top-right small sun/moon control. Clear hierarchy and 40 percent uninterrupted black breathing space. The drawing may overlap the empty right edge of the heading region but never obscure text. A tiny handwritten 'short way round.' sits near Perry. Thoughtful contemporary graphic design, mathematical play and animated-drawing personality. No glowing portals, no cosmic scene, no stars, no sci-fi interface, no photorealistic laptop, no glass, no popup paper books, no torn paper, no room diorama, no cards or fake metrics. Use exactly 3 nested large frames so illusion remains legible and restrained. Make it feel like Perry understands a dimension the rest of the page does not.
